events.name: The Belfort Events
events.description: The Belfort hosts regular Saturday nights and themed events throughout the year. Valid student ID required; tiered ticket pricing available.

events.name: MURDA BEATZ @ LOST LOVE
events.description: Murda Beatz brings his underground house sound to Lost Love for Frosh Week Saturday. Fresh off his #1 hit 'Baby,' expect nonstop beats and chart-topping tracks. 19+.

events.name: EX x ZY Presents: WESTERN OPEN ROOFTOP DARTY
events.description: Kick off frosh week at the rooftop darty! Dress all white and join EX x ZY for the season's first rooftop party. 19+ only.

events.name: BCKYRD LONDON
events.description: All-ages dance and electronic music festival at London International Airport. VIP packages include dedicated entry, VIP bars, and exclusive viewing areas.
